name: Apple Inc.

peers.name: Alphabet
peers.why: Android/Play Store platform rival; Pixel; services overlap

peers.name: Microsoft
peers.why: Software/services platform plus PCs and devices; mega-cap quality comparison

peers.name: Sony
peers.why: Consumer electronics with a digital services store

valuation.vl3_basis: trailing P/E, 5 years (price / last-12-month SEC diluted EPS), labelled

dm4.name: Services revenue growth
dm4.source: Apple quarterly results release, net sales by category (on results)
dm4.what: Growth in Apple's Services revenue (App Store, iCloud, Apple Music, payments) vs the same quarter last year.
dm4.why: Services is recurring and far more profitable than hardware, so it drives much of Apple's profit growth and its valuation.
dm4.bull_means: Services is growing fast: the high-margin engine is healthy.
dm4.bear_means: Services growth has slowed sharply: a hit to the most profitable part of the business.

dm4.name: iPhone revenue growth
dm4.source: Apple quarterly results release, net sales by category (on results)
dm4.what: Growth in iPhone revenue vs the same quarter last year.
dm4.why: iPhone is about half of Apple's revenue and brings customers into the Services ecosystem.

dm5.name: Apple smartphone shipments (research firms)
dm5.source: Counterpoint / IDC / Canalys quarterly press releases
dm5.measured_against: same calendar quarter a year earlier
dm5.latest: +15.3% (Q2 2026, IDC: 55.8m vs 48.4m units; Counterpoint reports +3%, see Known defects)
dm5.what: How many iPhones were shipped in the latest calendar quarter vs the same quarter a year earlier, from an independent research firm (IDC; firms can disagree, see Known defects).
dm5.why: It arrives before Apple reports, so it is an early outside read on demand.
dm5.bull_means: Shipments are growing: demand is holding up.

chains.what_changes: memory and advanced-chip shortage, prices up
chains.business_hit: component costs up -> gross margin down / product prices up -> demand risk
chains.company_levers: price rises, long-term supply deals, memory configurations

watch.name: DRAM spot price (DDR5 16Gb)
watch.source: DRAMeXchange (verify at build); fallback Micron (MU) price

tariffs on China-assembled products; Chinese demand/regulation

mix._note: Revenue mix (plan v0.4 section 'Revenue mix', not scored). match = patterns on the row label printed in the SEC filing; first pattern that gives a value wins; a pattern matching several labels adds them up. groups = where the filing reports profit or cost (margin level).
mix.note: Apple reports gross margin for Products and Services only, not for each product. So iPhone, Mac, iPad and Wearables all show the Products gross margin.

_onboard_note: Price at the first staging build (29 Sep 2026 close): the reference for O6 winner discipline ("up since onboarded") until a positions feed exists.
